<subject>Fw: Reclassification of Capitalised Interest</subject>
<body>
FYI - If this change is approved, reclassifying Capitalised Interest within Other Income - Miscellaneous will increase PBT by £560K for 2024 (Credit Risk £400K, Treasury £160K).
</body>
<quoted>
 -----Original Message-----
From: 	Evans, Josh  
Sent:	Thursday, 19 September 2024 10:43
To:	Marsh, Donald
Subject:	FW: Reclassification of Capitalised Interest


fyi
 -----Original Message-----
From: 	Evans, Josh  
Sent:	Thursday, 19 September 2024 10:40
To:	Perkins, Jonathan; Robertson, Gemma
Cc:	Walters Jr., Paul; Smith, Ryan; Marshall, Robert; Carey, Howard; Graham, Amanda; Johnson, Valerie; Hughes, Dylan; Walters, Russell; Coleman, Maurice
Subject:	Reclassification of Capitalised Interest


Request to remap the below two SAP accounts for Capitalised Interest from Hyperion account 1755 (Other Corporate Lending)
to Hyperion 1690 (Other Income - Miscellaneous)               Effective: for SEPTEMBER 2024 Close.

     SAP Accounts      Description                             From: Current Mapping              To: New Mapping
          78892830     Capitalised Interest Settlement         1755_78892830                     1690_78892830
          60765877     Capitalised Interest                    1755_60765877                     1690_60765877


 




Capitalised Interest (SAP accounts 78892830-Capitalised Interest Settlement and 60765877-Capitalised Interest) currently map to Corporate Lending 1755-interest capitalised. The only business units using these two SAP accounts as of August and the YTD credit balances in each are units 141-£425,420, 179-£262,335, 413-£10,150 (debit), 536-£2,457,610, 60-£73,120 and 62-£232,785.

In conclusion I have reviewed the proposed remapping with representatives of the various Treasury companies and they confirmed the remapping would not cause any issues.

PS.   Please notify me or Maurice Coleman when the change is implemented in Leeds so he can adjust the same accounts in EOC Hyperion. 
</quoted>
